# Nadeem Dev Apps

> Nadeem Mazhar is a solo developer in Pakistan building websites, Windows apps,
> Android apps, and backends, with AI doing the heavy lifting. This site is his
> portfolio; products live as sub-pages.

- [Home](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/)
- [Tsumly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/): local-first personal expense and loan ledger. "Every amount adds up." Smart multi-loan repayment split, optional Google Drive backup.
- [Tsumly Features](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/features/)
- [Tsumly Gallery](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/gallery/)
- [Tsumly About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/about/)
- [Tsumly Download](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/tsumly/download/)
- [Kaizenly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/): a strict, local-first focus guard, built from scratch.
- [Kaizenly Features](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/features/)
- [Kaizenly Gallery](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/gallery/)
- [Kaizenly About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/about/)
- [Kaizenly Download](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/download/)
- [MsgLoop](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/msgloop/): a WhatsApp sender for Android. Send one message many times, now or on a schedule. Local-first, no account, no server.

## Notes

- The site is a static Astro site. Design tokens live in DESIGN.md in the repo root.
- The Privacy page carries the privacy-policy URL used by the Tsumly app's Google OAuth setup.
- The brand mark is a "Stack in a pill" logo: [logo.svg](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/logo.svg).
